productsAreNotBlended: The 30 m HRSC and 200 m HRSC-MOLA crops are distinct products. They are never averaged, resampled together, or presented as one uniform high-resolution DEM.

source.publisher: ESA / DLR / Freie Universitat Berlin / NASA JPL
source.citation: Persaud et al. (2021), 30 m HRSC DTM mosaic of Gale Crater, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.5808354

crop.method: Gale overview bounds plus 1 km derivative buffer

processing.slope: Horn 3x3 finite difference with per-row cos(latitude) east spacing
processing.nodataPolicy: Nonfinite posts and the product nodata value are invalid. A cell is routeable only when all nine 3x3 elevation posts are valid. No filling, interpolation, or smoothing across gaps.
processing.distanceModel: Mars 2000 sphere R=3,396,190 m; per-row east ground spacing and 8-connected diagonal hypot

registration.reason: Precise local DEM-to-CTX co-registration is not certified. Published coordinates are retained; no shift was fitted.

limitations: 30 m posting is a grid spacing, not a guaranteed 30 m effective resolving power.
Horn 3x3 slopes have approximately 90 m support and smooth out boulders, small scarps, sand traps, and suit-scale obstacles.
Absolute horizontal/vertical accuracy and slope error are not quantitatively certified.
CTX optical co-registration is unverified locally; no shift was applied.
The crop covers the audited Gale exploration footprint plus a 1 km derivative buffer, not all of Gale Crater.
No roughness, obstacle, trafficability, or hazard dataset is included.

slopeSupportMeters.note: Horn 3x3 support: three 200 m north steps; east support is about 598 m at 4.7 deg S.

source.publisher: USGS Astrogeology Science Center / NASA / ESA
source.citation: Fergason, Hare, and Laura (2018), USGS HRSC-MOLA blended DEM

processing.slope: Horn 3x3 finite difference with per-row cos(latitude) east spacing
processing.nodataPolicy: Nonfinite posts and the product nodata value are invalid. A cell is routeable only when all nine 3x3 elevation posts are valid. No filling, interpolation, or smoothing across gaps.
processing.distanceModel: Mars 2000 sphere R=3,396,190 m; per-row east ground spacing and 8-connected diagonal hypot

registration.reason: Precise local DEM-to-CTX co-registration is not certified. Published coordinates are retained; no shift was fitted.

limitations: 200 m posting and approximately 600 m gradient support are far too coarse for suit-scale or rover-scale hazard assessment.
The product blends HRSC and MOLA observations; local source quality and seams are not mapped per pixel.
CTX optical co-registration is unverified locally.
This crop is a regional comparison product, not a replacement for the 30 m primary routing grid.
No roughness, obstacle, trafficability, or hazard dataset is included.
